blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A career is the path of your working life. At the beginning, you start in a junior role. After a few years, you can become a senior. Later, maybe a manager, or a specialist in your area.

HR helps people to plan their career. This is called career pathing. It shows the steps from one role to the next.

When you know where you want to go, it is easier to arrive. A plan gives you a clear next step.

items.q: How does a career usually start?
items.why: "At the beginning, you start in a junior role."

items.q: What is career pathing?
options: A way to plan your career with HR
items.why: "HR helps people to plan their career. This is called career pathing."

items.q: The text suggests that a specialist is…
options: another way to grow, not only becoming a manager
the first step in a career
items.why: Inferência: o texto cita "a manager, or a specialist" como opções — especializar-se é outra forma de crescer.

items.q: Why is a plan useful, according to the text?
options: It makes it easier to arrive where you want
items.why: "When you know where you want to go, it is easier to arrive."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you must stay in the same role forever
HR is not important for careers
knowing your goal helps you grow at work
items.why: Inferência: todo o texto liga saber o objetivo a crescer e chegar lá.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com Mariana sobre o próximo passo na carreira. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Mariana, thank you for this meeting. I really want to talk about my next step in the company, because I am thinking a lot about my future here.

I started here three years ago in a junior role. I learned a lot, and now I feel ready to grow. I am going to apply for a senior position next year. That is my main plan, and I am very happy about it.

I love my area, so maybe I am going to become a specialist, not a manager. I am not sure yet. Both paths look good to me. Can HR help me plan this? I want clear steps, so I always know where I am going.

This year, I am going to take a leadership course. Next quarter, I am going to lead a small project in São Paulo. I think this is a good way to show my work and grow at the same time.

A promotion is not the only goal for me. I just want a real opportunity to develop and to do good work. Thank you so much for your support, Mariana. It means a lot to me.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How long has Sophie worked at the company?
items.why: "I started here three years ago in a junior role."

items.q: What is Sophie going to do next year?
items.why: "I am going to apply for a senior position next year."

items.q: What is Sophie going to do this year to develop?
items.why: "This year, I am going to take a leadership course."

items.q: The listening suggests that Sophie…
options: cares more about the title than the work
does not want any help from HR
is not interested in her area
wants to grow, not only get a promotion
items.why: Inferência: "A promotion is not the only goal… I just want a real opportunity to develop."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about her next career step?
options: Ready and positive, but still deciding the path
Sure she wants to be a manager
items.why: Inferência: ela se sente pronta ("ready to grow"), mas ainda não decidiu entre especialista e gestora ("I am not sure yet").

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She has a long career in finance." A career is…
items.why: Career = carreira: o caminho da sua vida profissional.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "After five years, she got a ___ and became a senior."
items.why: Promotion = promoção: subir para um cargo mais alto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "He is a data ___; he knows this area very well."
items.why: Specialist = especialista: quem domina bem uma área.

items.q: "This new project is a great opportunity for you." An opportunity is…
items.why: Opportunity = oportunidade: uma boa chance.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A career path has clear ___, from junior to senior."
items.why: Step = passo: cada etapa do caminho da carreira.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em reuniões sobre carreira. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I am going to apply for a senior role." To apply for means to…
options: ask officially for a job or role
items.why: Apply for = candidatar-se, pedir oficialmente uma vaga.

items.q: "HR will sign off on your development plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "I want to move up in the company." To move up means to…
items.why: Move up = subir para um cargo mais alto.

items.q: "She always follows through on her plans." This means she…
options: asks others to do the work
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting with HR." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar, organizar (uma reunião, por exemplo).
